label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is a true positive. The data flow traces from requestHeader "X-Correlation-Id" (source) to variable corr (intermediate) to response.getWriter().println (sink). The resolved sink value is the raw header content, which is written directly into the HTML response body without HTML encoding. Although the header name suggests metadata, custom headers can be manipulated by attackers (e.g., via proxy), making the reflected content exploitable for XSS.

evidence.note: Source extracts X-Correlation-Id header, sink prints it directly to HTML response without encoding.
